Beautiful kitchen set! It took us about two hours to put together, but the instructions were easy to follow. Just take your time, follow each step, and you’ll be okay. Once it was finished, it looked adorable and felt very sturdy. The little details, lights, and accessories make it so cute. Definitely worth the time to assemble—my little one loves it! 💕👩‍🍳✨

Great purchase! This toy kitchen has made my hobby projects so much easier. Its high load capacity is perfect for my workload. The structure is sturdy, and all the parts feel very high-end. Assembly is also very simple.
Recibimos la cocinita en el tiempo establecido y fue rápido. El montaje es sencillo y práctico. Además la cocina es tal cuál las imágenes. A mi hija le encantó. La recomiendo al 100%.
This kitchen is the perfect size and quality for little ones. My 2-year-old granddaughter loves it. Assembly was easy.
My daughter loves this kitchen. It looks realistic, is made of wood, and has great quality. The directions are easy to follow.

This is a great product for young kids. The boys and girls both love playing pretend with this! It is very sturdy and takes rough play very well. The realistic aspects like belt and price scanning is so great and work well! It was not difficult to put together just a bit time consuming but worth it for sure! Love that it comes with some foods and basket. This is a must have!

Solid and pretty easy to put together. I would love it more if it were multicolored, but it serves it's purpose. Plenty of storage with all the shelves which are also great for play and stocking their products for sale. My daughter especially loves the conveyor belt which has a knob they can turn to move the items down the checkout just like the real grocery store. A hit for my 5 year old and her friends.

Item arrived as pictured and described. I am honestly blown away by the quality of this pretend play grocery shop. Upon opening the box and laying everything out i was shocked and pleased by the execution of each piece. Im not gonna lie one of the pieces arrived pretty beat up but its honestly nothing that cant be fixed or just looked over, minor damage. The attention to detail is pretty great with this stand and you cant tell alot of thought went into the making of it. The instructions were simple to follow, setup probably took me and my other half about 45min. To complete with a power tool gun,( I'd say a tool gun is well needed.) The accessories and amount of pieces you get in addition are great too! I love that the "scanner" lights up and beeps when scanning the items and my son was busy playing with my boyfriend with it so I'd say its pretty engaging for a 4 year old. Its a well made product that does what it says it'll do, a cute concept, well executed and leaves much room for the imagination to flow for hours of non-stop play. Definitely worth the price and i Definitely do recommend!

I received this VEVOR wooden grocery store playset as a gift, and it's been an absolute hit from the moment it was assembled. The conveyor belt actually moves when you turn the little knob, the scanner beeps realistically, and the cash register with the card reader makes everything feel just like the real supermarket. The kids immediately started lining up their stuffed animals as customers and taking turns being the cashier – I've never seen them so engaged with a single toy for this long. The quality surprised me in the best way; it's sturdy MDF wood with nicely rounded edges, and even after weeks of daily use (including some enthusiastic "shopping cart" crashes), nothing has chipped or broken. It comes with a ton of accessories – tons of wooden fruits and veggies, a working scale, reusable shopping bags – so they can play right out of the box without needing extra pieces. Perfect gift for any 3-8 year old who loves role-playing – definitely worth the space it takes up in the playroom. 🛒🥦
